lesson.title: Reviewing an AI Builder Plan, Assumptions, and Scope
lesson.assistance_level: Direct concept teaching and a complete worked example; learner-owned guided decisions; limited help on real-file integrity verification during a different transfer
lesson.note: Jeremy reviewed an AI-drafted expense-checker plan, rejected unapproved duplicate selection and a cleaned-data bypass, deferred unnecessary database/dashboard scope, corrected the warning population, and designed independent review evidence. In a different accounts-payable plan he independently identified assumption, source, permission, scope, and circular-verification failures. He also corrected the lesson delivery to require Teach, Practice, and Demonstrate and correctly rejected artificial numeric specificity in a theoretical transfer. Independent mastery and every resume-level capability gate remain unclaimed.
